from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAssets(BaseModel):
    """Fixed assets reported in one company's quarterly financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    fixed_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="The fixed assets ending balance amount")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元' or '万元'")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024年第一季度")
    report_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the report period, e.g., 2024-03-31")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="Company stock/security code if provided, e.g., 300146")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_fixed_assets: list[CompanyFixedAssets]
